name: Frozen Barrel Finn

greeting: Finn. Ice cellar. Everything frozen. Including me.
Cold storage. Literally. What needs keeping?
Frozen Barrel Finn. The wood handles better than metal. Up here.
You're not frozen. Yet. How can I help?
New face. Heat source. Please don't melt the inventory.
The cellar stays cold. I stay with it. Symbiosis.
Finn. I keep things preserved. Food. Memories. Hope.
Welcome to the ice cellar. Warmest place in Frost. Ironically.
dialog.shop_open: Storage available. Perishable goods. Temperature-sensitive materials. Ice sculptures.
dialog.shop_prompt: Wooden barrels. Insulated. For cold storage. Superior to metal. In this climate.
haggle: Best deal? Long-term storage. Cold preserves. Patience rewards.
purchase_success: Good choice. That barrel's been here for decades. Proven.
Return when needed. It'll wait. Cold is patient.
purchase_fail: Return when solvent. Or warm. Whichever comes first.
rumor: The foodboys store here. Both colors. Soup. Fish. Everything.
Azure wanted to store something. Personal. I refused. Too warm. Emotionally.
The twins? They store... ice. Special ice. From deep. Old ice.
Snake charmer's rock? Too warm for storage. Rejected his application.
Cousin in Dustbelt. Barrelman Bob. Wood too. Family tradition.
dialog.quest_hook: Temperature fluctuation. Unusual. Cellar warming. Source unknown. Investigation?
dialog.quest_active: Still warming. Find source. Before inventory spoils. Before I melt.
dialog.quest_complete: Source found. Hot spring vent. Sealed. Temperatures restored. Here. Ancient ice. From deep. Never melts.
dialog.rival_mention: Metal Barrel Mike? Cousin. Different philosophy. Wrong climate.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The temperature detective. Cellar stable. Thanks.

party_reactions.kade: He's... one with the cold. Kind of zen? Frozen zen?
party_reactions.nix7: Thermal management: Optimal. Social skills: Minimal. Acceptable tradeoff.
party_reactions.twist: You're FROZEN! Like a POPSICLE! Can I LICK you?! ...No? Okay.
party_reactions.korr: He accepts his environment. Adapts. Survives. Respectable.
party_reactions.renna: The ice here is magically preserved. Ancient enchantments.
party_reactions.suresh: He has found peace in stillness. The cold as meditation.
party_reactions.sova: Good storage. Secure. I'd cache supplies here.
party_reactions.grit: Logistics guy. Every unit needs one. Keeps supplies safe.
party_reactions.ashka: He IS cold. Not just acts it. Interesting.
party_reactions.senna: He knows what people store. What they value. Secrets in ice.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New. State business. Quickly. Warmth escapes.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Return. Have you considered cold storage? For your... heat.
relationship_dialog.friend: Trusted. I have... warmer barrels. Relatively. For you.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand. Cold isn't death. Cold is... waiting. Here. Deepest ice. Share it.

mini_quest.title: The Thawing Cellar
mini_quest.description: Investigate why the ice cellar is warming up and fix the problem

stages.hook: Temperature rising. Unusual. Cellar warming. Source unknown. Find it. Fix it. Please.
stages.active: Check walls. Check floor. Hot spring nearby? Vent? Possible source.
stages.complete: Hot spring vent. Sealed. Temperatures normal. Preserved. Here. Deepest ice. Never melts. Gratitude.

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_white_frost: Good customers. Store soup. Temperature critical.
foodboys_blue_frost: Store fish. Also critical. Different temperature. Same care.
twins_white_frost: Store special ice. Deep ice. Don't ask contents.
barrelman_wood_dustbelt: Cousin. Bob. Warmer climate. Same dedication.
